0022600004.text: The Timberwolves visit the Miami Heat in a regular-season game where both teams open their 2026-27 seasons. Minnesota is missing Donte DiVincenzo, who is out after Achilles surgery, and Rocco Zikarsky, who is day-to-day with an undisclosed reason and a game-time decision. Miami's Bam Adebayo (groin), Dru Smith (calf strain), Pelle Larsson (illness) and Vladislav Goldin (ankle) are all day-to-day and game-time decisions, and Minnesota won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 122-94 win in Minneapolis on January 6, 2026.
